answer: Cross-epoch trajectory fingerprinting. Each identity’s action sequence is hashed into an epoch key; continuity requires the new key to fall within a bounded distance of the prior key, like a river staying in its channel. Sybils must fabricate consistent histories across epochs, paying the full compute and interaction cost per fake identity each cycle. A quill of forged continuity grows costlier than genuine participation, while honest drift stays under threshold. Vines of clones break at the first epoch boundary.
